Hangover supplements are ` [Highlight start] over-the-counter pills, drinks, and powders marketed to ease next-day symptoms like headaches, fatigue, and nausea [Highlight end] ` , though clinical evidence for their effectiveness is limited. Hydration, food, and drinking in moderation remain the most reliable ways to prevent or reduce hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXpEosMyf0gbctTW8GA7RC60AvxQKywgrEcVhBbFRathv9XkL67TJonMqwzWQjsq8epSA00hR2A4oeIMPaqvDN8Uzih1N02NBpNJ2Ipj6XKkwklcXVLaKoaSoB3BOt4PQN-MIiXLrqOVrythCnBBOLT33BD5uCO2z-)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXmXaHnRUpKqobmAFZS1IF7_I1-IO3kZK_qaMqbhly8hRAso08qd2tmXDrrkedChObsCEd0bn8hz9KXAehVphp7mWfiW_Dz4nPIm3eWrFXv_LPvK4DW23DXurLjKgkPKfF18KBVguB6vkkpdR-1drH)

### Common Ingredients & What They Aim to Do

- **Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium):** Help replenish fluids and minerals lost from alcohol's diuretic effect.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)
- **DHM (dihydromyricetin) & prickly pear:** Plant extracts marketed to support liver function and reduce inflammation, though human clinical proof is sparse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wS57tTYxV3nkZnli7cnIPcJTPkmWfpQk85FIc8VrA2ZD6prQkToXFRvISzvA8yiNbsd0bhtCRu-6PDMAAUdjgg_r6YEWC4lHeudU54_8LOW_XZCiog5ljx8rHswmoZ5yjR2A3EYit0QQ8rlimRRh_Cb2slNIvi5385VzHNCMnEHQyyTRvg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)
- **L-cysteine & NAC (N-acetylcysteine):** Amino acids involved in antioxidant production and breaking down acetaldehyde (a toxic alcohol byproduct), with limited human hangover data.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wS57tTYxV3nkZnli7cnIPcJTPkmWfpQk85FIc8VrA2ZD6prQkToXFRvISzvA8yiNbsd0bhtCRu-6PDMAAUdjgg_r6YEWC4lHeudU54_8LOW_XZCiog5ljx8rHswmoZ5yjR2A3EYit0QQ8rlimRRh_Cb2slNIvi5385VzHNCMnEHQyyTRvg)
- **B vitamins & vitamin C:** Aim to offset depleted nutrients and support energy or antioxidant defenses.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXJkSt0KGmu3iclUT96raSOqmViS7QCUcH4yOADAVr1DpJIRwZQK91xbKBJSv8a9DmYaaROUyLsCNAL3G0ed0rjZLE9W3fp5s_RPI97HGdq995hsd_DGg0FK_hpjxgaGB8rUTbAdqv2MPkM3fTX7f8EvCGWGbcRQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)
- **Ginger or peppermint:** Often included to soothe nausea or stomach upset.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)
- **Caffeine:** A stimulant used to fight morning sluggishness, though it does not cure underlying dehydration or alcohol effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF1wS57tTYxV3nkZnli7cnIPcJTPkmWfpQk85FIc8VrA2ZD6prQkToXFRvISzvA8yiNbsd0bhtCRu-6PDMAAUdjgg_r6YEWC4lHeudU54_8LOW_XZCiog5ljx8rHswmoZ5yjR2A3EYit0QQ8rlimRRh_Cb2slNIvi5385VzHNCMnEHQyyTRvg)

### Popular Options & Where to Shop

- **Capsules & gummies:** Products like **Cheers Restore**, **UNDO Gummies** , and **Himalaya PartySmart** combine herbs, amino acids, or vitamins.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXpEosMyf0gbctTW8GA7RC60AvxQKywgrEcVhBbFRathv9XkL67TJonMqwzWQjsq8epSA00hR2A4oeIMPaqvDN8Uzih1N02NBpNJ2Ipj6XKkwklcXVLaKoaSoB3BOt4PQN-MIiXLrqOVrythCnBBOLT33BD5uCO2z-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX33KOLFHPpBl_3X7OxAP4hepOyhdTJJTifr9yeJc2b2PAEAlKeT56C7_KvQvXlFOQRLvtAteCQrojymdSrMjyfdlMDr_gngae7hJsbDeyWygGqKKayvTacV2thTBW7ptX18E)
- **Hydration & recovery drinks:** Options like **Morning Recovery** and **Waterboy** focus on electrolytes and recovery blends.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX33KOLFHPpBl_3X7OxAP4hepOyhdTJJTifr9yeJc2b2PAEAlKeT56C7_KvQvXlFOQRLvtAteCQrojymdSrMjyfdlMDr_gngae7hJsbDeyWygGqKKayvTacV2thTBW7ptX18E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXpEosMyf0gbctTW8GA7RC60AvxQKywgrEcVhBbFRathv9XkL67TJonMqwzWQjsq8epSA00hR2A4oeIMPaqvDN8Uzih1N02NBpNJ2Ipj6XKkwklcXVLaKoaSoB3BOt4PQN-MIiXLrqOVrythCnBBOLT33BD5uCO2z-)
- **Retailers:** You can browse current inventory and pricing at [Walgreens](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXqar7-uO5GQYH0yE_TZofppLDfKEvA9RsAtZ0YtMBMhaIzJi1LgecatnV2awW1o-2RvYWrFLpOHxuRnzDfuMWdtJfCb7-lKj_9Ea7Uwlpb2jjLgVkI-92rUBqgdQ7B_5gmqfe323jdQ9ifQnjSjTy2A), [Target](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX33KOLFHPpBl_3X7OxAP4hepOyhdTJJTifr9yeJc2b2PAEAlKeT56C7_KvQvXlFOQRLvtAteCQrojymdSrMjyfdlMDr_gngae7hJsbDeyWygGqKKayvTacV2thTBW7ptX18E) , and [Amazon](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXpEosMyf0gbctTW8GA7RC60AvxQKywgrEcVhBbFRathv9XkL67TJonMqwzWQjsq8epSA00hR2A4oeIMPaqvDN8Uzih1N02NBpNJ2Ipj6XKkwklcXVLaKoaSoB3BOt4PQN-MIiXLrqOVrythCnBBOLT33BD5uCO2z-).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXqar7-uO5GQYH0yE_TZofppLDfKEvA9RsAtZ0YtMBMhaIzJi1LgecatnV2awW1o-2RvYWrFLpOHxuRnzDfuMWdtJfCb7-lKj_9Ea7Uwlpb2jjLgVkI-92rUBqgdQ7B_5gmqfe323jdQ9ifQnjSjTy2A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHEIkXX33KOLFHPpBl_3X7OxAP4hepOyhdTJJTifr9yeJc2b2PAEAlKeT56C7_KvQvXlFOQRLvtAteCQrojymdSrMjyfdlMDr_gngae7hJsbDeyWygGqKKayvTacV2thTBW7ptX18E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXpEosMyf0gbctTW8GA7RC60AvxQKywgrEcVhBbFRathv9XkL67TJonMqwzWQjsq8epSA00hR2A4oeIMPaqvDN8Uzih1N02NBpNJ2Ipj6XKkwklcXVLaKoaSoB3BOt4PQN-MIiXLrqOVrythCnBBOLT33BD5uCO2z-)

### Important Safety Notes

- **Unproven cures:** Supplements are not FDA-approved to cure, treat, or prevent hangovers, and they do not protect your liver or make heavy drinking safe.
- **Medication & alcohol interactions:** Be cautious combining pain relievers with alcohol—for example, acetaminophen (Tylenol) can stress the liver, and NSAIDs like ibuprofen can irritate the stomach or affect kidneys. Check with a doctor or pharmacist if you take regular medications or have liver, kidney, or stomach conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXmXaHnRUpKqobmAFZS1IF7_I1-IO3kZK_qaMqbhly8hRAso08qd2tmXDrrkedChObsCEd0bn8hz9KXAehVphp7mWfiW_Dz4nPIm3eWrFXv_LPvK4DW23DXurLjKgkPKfF18KBVguB6vkkpdR-1drH)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgwEBxCJF12VlbkWp3W5ivXj_LWmoJjdFVzJu0w-Anz7N8Y0nEbJXBz0F_Mf_UFayO1EtMAo3TfrDvKrNl2PhiSL21YswVCmmAk7lmHkAqGAk36ATOvxOWaMgcpMzEcFP-PRI_TNpLOs7EBNdK3bCbls83HUwE9yL4JCuxoNSnZEe8wnPTg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF1y8IMNwQAVmzElVo1aqrFp9HBBD3-zMFSRQPmC2RIMnA3nZacBK0KwQ_nwbdOkUs4AX5nrbPNdfkZs2_B2gix9wVTA6bK9cMh5Yos1nKmnRE_EcxM8fUG-PFGFUcQSDDvcZvQqTg2ZvNgoyT1nbOh5lqCxrV8wjBuNt59K28USbP-3KssrOiyOrndMcD)

For deeper reading on the science and testing behind these products, see [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY) and [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXJkSt0KGmu3iclUT96raSOqmViS7QCUcH4yOADAVr1DpJIRwZQK91xbKBJSv8a9DmYaaROUyLsCNAL3G0ed0rjZLE9W3fp5s_RPI97HGdq995hsd_DGg0FK_hpjxgaGB8rUTbAdqv2MPkM3fTX7f8EvCGWGbcRQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1xx_y-g5qhPT6OTOFaO1dF9X__oHcVQRVCi11KHnJ95Qicnl0TLsnhpPu-lSNKqakc5dy6CoED41tfzxD5-pb6rli5c5O5ztPwFsOSHVhUf5Y6AudOJ0y0MHKWkxDnPzsX_bpNccWdBZJ5bMzeWKGvjZNFDE9Vat6k83HRfaOwKmSBY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXJkSt0KGmu3iclUT96raSOqmViS7QCUcH4yOADAVr1DpJIRwZQK91xbKBJSv8a9DmYaaROUyLsCNAL3G0ed0rjZLE9W3fp5s_RPI97HGdq995hsd_DGg0FK_hpjxgaGB8rUTbAdqv2MPkM3fTX7f8EvCGWGbcRQ)To help narrow down what fits best, tell me:

- **How you plan to use it** (e.g., before drinking, next-morning recovery, or mainly hydration)
- **Preferred format** (capsules, gummies, drink mix, or ready-to-drink)
- **Any specific preferences or limits** (such as sugar-free, vegan, or a target **budget**)

items.title: Important Safety Notes
items.text: Unproven cures: Supplements are not FDA-approved to cure, treat, or prevent hangovers, and they do not protect your liver or make heavy drinking safe. Medication & alcohol interactions: Be cautious combining pain relievers with alcohol—for example, acetaminophen (Tylenol) can stress the liver, and NSAIDs like ibuprofen can irritate the stomach or affect kidneys. Check with a doctor or pharmacist if you take regular medications or have liver, kidney, or stomach conditions.
